items.stem: In IAM Identity Center, what is a permission set?

options.text: A reusable collection of policies that defines access when assigned to a user/group in an account
options.rationale: Correct: permission sets define access provisioned into accounts.
Permission sets are not IAM user passwords.
That is unrelated networking, not identity.
A bucket policy is resource-level, not an Identity Center permission set.

items.explanation: Correct: a permission set defines assignable access.

items.stem: Which practice best applies least privilege in Identity Center?

options.text: Assign narrowly scoped permission sets matching each group's job
options.rationale: Correct: scoped permission sets follow least privilege.

options.text: Use a single shared login for the team
options.rationale: Shared logins break accountability and least privilege.
